title: HostEventDeliveryViewDocument
description: Server-owned manager projection of one live event assistance message, written ahead of time by triggers on eventAssistanceMessages, eventAssistanceGuests, eventAttendees, events, operationWorkItems, operationRuns and organizers. view holds the row the retired listEventAssistanceDeliveries callable returned for this message, evaluated at evaluatedAt. Time enters the row only through the manual-handoff action: relevantUntilMillis is the instant at which the message expires or its live window closes, and the phone treats actions as empty once its clock reaches it, so the view needs no sweep. A view exists only for a live intent; a rehearsal or deleted message has none. A source that fails validation records sourceCoverage invalidSource and incompleteSource, keeps the previous view (null when there was none) and never throws. Managers list an event's views under rules by organizerId and eventId; authority comes from the organizer document, never from the view.
x-owner: Host event delivery view evaluator (hostReadModels event delivery view triggers)

messageId.description: Equals the document id and the message's messageId.

organizerId.description: The message's organizer; rules key on it.

createdAt.description: When the message was created, in milliseconds.

revision.description: Increases by one with every committed evaluation that changed the document.

evaluatedAt.description: When the evaluation that last changed the document committed; the time the view row describes.

sourceCoverage.description: Whether the last evaluation read every source validly. invalidSource keeps the previous view.

incompleteSource.description: The collection whose document failed validation (eventAssistanceMessages, eventAssistanceGuests, eventAttendees, events, organizers or operationWorkItems), or null when coverage is complete.

relevantUntilMillis.description: The instant from which view.actions no longer apply: the earlier of the message's expiry and, for a message whose live window closes at the event's end, that end. Null when view.actions is empty.

view.description: The manager row; null only when the first evaluation was already invalid.
